Deprecated v2 endpoints for managing transactional and insight data. Use this
API to add, replace, retrieve, and delete individual records within named
collections; bulk-import records asynchronously; check import status and retrieve
import reports; query all records in a collection at account level; list available
collections; and empty a collection. All endpoints in this spec are deprecated —
new integrations should use the Insight Data Service API instead.
